newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray says to invest $70 mln in new U.S. plant.
newsitem.headline: Toray says to invest $70 mln in new U.S. plant.

text.p: Japanese synthetic fibre maker Toray Industries Inc said on Tuesday it would invest $70 million to build a carbon fibre plant in the United States.

Toray and its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Toray Industries (America) Inc, have set up a new company to manufacture and market the Polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based carbon fibre, Toray said in a statement.
The new company, Toray Carbon Fibers America Inc, is capitalised at $45 million, with Toray owning a 95 percent stake and its U.S. subsidiary the remaining five percent, Toray said.
The new production line, with annual production capacity of 1,800 tonnes, is expected to start operating in April 1999, Toray added. The line will be built in Decatur, Alabama, it said.
PAN-based carbon fibre is used in civil engineering as well as in the construction of ships and vehicles.
